# proxmox_storage_import_metadata (Data Source)

Reads import metadata of a volume from `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/import-metadata`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_import_metadata" "m" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  storage = "local"
  volume  = "local:import/disk.img"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `volume` (String)

### Read-Only

- `metadata` (String)
